description: This file contains a singleton object 'Dpad' that provides utility functions to determine if a given key code corresponds to vertical or horizontal D-Pad navigation keys in an Android TV application.

methods.name: isVertical
methods.description: Checks if the provided keyCode corresponds to vertical D-Pad navigation (UP or DOWN).

methods.name: isHorizontal
methods.description: Checks if the provided keyCode corresponds to horizontal D-Pad navigation (LEFT or RIGHT).
